listings.headline: Half an acre of SR 200 frontage at the Callahan gateway, rezoning in motion
listings.summary: Exceptional development opportunity on SR 200 near the growing Town of Callahan. This vacant 0.49-acre parcel (21,344 SF) offers outstanding visibility along the area's primary east-west corridor with excellent exposure to daily traffic and convenient access to Jacksonville, I-95, and US 301. Located in an expanding business district, the property is well positioned for future investment or owner-user development.
listings.positioning: Professional office, retail, service business, flex space, warehouse, or another commercial project — long-term potential in one of Nassau County's growing commercial corridors. Buyers verify the rezoning status, permitted uses, utilities, and development requirements with the appropriate authorities.

listings.headline: A move-in-ready 1938 brick ranch in St. Nicholas / South Shores
listings.summary: Charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath brick ranch in Jacksonville's desirable St. Nicholas/South Shores neighborhood. Original hardwood floors and doors, an updated kitchen with newer appliances, an updated bathroom, and a new A/C installed in 2023. The fully fenced backyard has a new deck and outdoor fireplace area; a detached workshop/garage provides flexible space for storage, hobbies, or a home office, and the crawl space is fully encapsulated.
listings.positioning: Minutes from San Marco, downtown Jacksonville, shopping, dining, medical centers, and major roadways. Detached carport, wood-burning fireplace, central heat; dishwasher, dryer, electric range, microwave, refrigerator, and washer convey.
